what.title: What is a WMap account?
what.text: WMap works without an account. You only need one to share tours or plugins and to rate tours. You sign in with your OpenStreetMap account; WMap stores only your OSM name and OSM user number – no password and no email address.

deleted.title: What gets deleted
deleted.name: your name and OSM user number on the WMap server
deleted.tours: all tours you have saved – private and published – including others’ ratings of them
deleted.plugins: all plugins you have created – private and published, with uploaded data
deleted.ratings: your ratings and comments on other people’s tours
deleted.final: Deletion is immediate and permanent; nothing of it remains on the server.
deleted.not_server: Not on the server: recorded tracks, saved places, offline maps and settings. They stay on your device until you delete the app or the site data in the browser. Your OpenStreetMap account and everything you have contributed there stays – you manage that on openstreetmap.org.

now.title: Delete now
now.hint: This deletes the WMap account that belongs to the OpenStreetMap account you are signed in with.

no_login.title: Can’t sign in?
no_login.text: If you can no longer sign in, write to contact@wuefl.de with your OpenStreetMap name and – if possible – the name of one of your tours or plugins. We will then delete the account by hand, within 30 days at the latest, and confirm it to you.

confirm.title: Really delete account?
confirm.text: Your WMap account and all your tours, plugins and ratings will be deleted immediately and permanently. This cannot be undone. Your OpenStreetMap account stays as it is.

intro.title: What it’s about
intro.text: A plugin folder is an ordinary folder on your device – or in Nextcloud, Drive, Syncthing … WMap reads map layers and extensions from it. You can add several folders; WMap remembers them, and “Read again” picks up changed files.
intro.layer: Just a layer: put a GeoJSON file in the folder – done.
intro.named: Layer with a name, description, colour: a subfolder with a wmap-plugin.json.
intro.tiles: Map tiles (e.g. a geological map, WMS): also via wmap-plugin.json.
intro.extension: A proper plugin with program code (extension): a JavaScript file that does something on the map.

where.title: Where it works
where.app: WMap app (Android, Windows, macOS, Linux): choose a folder, WMap remembers it.
where.chrome: Chrome and Edge (also as an installed web app): the same – after a restart the browser asks once whether WMap may read again.
where.firefox: Firefox and Safari: only read once. These browsers don’t offer the interface for permanent folder access (File System Access) – Mozilla considers it too risky, because a web page could use it to write to real folders. To update, simply choose the same folder again.
where.add: To add: Plugins → Add → “Add plugin folder”.

layout.title: Structure of a folder
layout.code:
My plugins/
├── Hides.geojson                 → layer “Hides”
├── Network/
│   ├── wmap-plugin.json          → layer with name, description, colour
│   └── stations.geojson
├── Geology/
│   └── wmap-plugin.json          → map tiles (tiles)
└── WeatherWarning/
    ├── wmap-plugin.json          → extension (script)
    └── main.js
layout.loose_data: Loose .geojson/.json files each become one layer, named after the file.
layout.subfolder: Everything in a subfolder with wmap-plugin.json belongs to that plugin.
layout.depth: Subfolders up to 5 levels deep; files and folders starting with a dot are skipped.

tree.title: Folder structure explained
tree.code:
Your folder/
├─ settings.json            Settings
├─ Geplante Touren/         one GPX file per tour
├─ Aufgezeichnete Touren/
│  └─ 2026/09 September/    one GPX file per track (with heart rate & co.) or the watch’s FIT file
├─ Bus & Bahn/              one JSON file per saved connection
├─ Lesezeichen.json         Home, work, bookmarks and lists
├─ Unbekannte Dateien/         what couldn’t be read – deleted after 30 days
└─ Inhalt.json              Index for quick syncing
tree.hint: Every WMap that connects the same folder reads it and syncs with it. Use a folder just for WMap. GPX and FIT files from elsewhere (watch, Garmin, Komoot …) you simply drop in, anywhere: WMap asks what to do with them and sorts them into place – even from your own subfolders. A FIT file stays as the watch wrote it. WMap doesn’t touch other files (photos, documents). If you delete a tour file, the entry disappears in WMap too.

stats.text: To show how many people use WMap and which services are needed how often, WMap sends an anonymous message to the WMap server once a day: that the app was open today and how often it asked each service. No ID, no location, no search terms. You can change this at any time under Settings → Data.

3.1.1: Fix: after an update, some texts were sometimes missing (e.g. in the settings) or the map stayed blank. An update is now only applied once all files have been loaded completely and match
3.1.0: WMap is now available in German, English, French, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian and Danish – right from the start in your device’s language. Language and colour scheme can be chosen straight in the welcome screen
Better search: if the search service doesn’t answer, WMap keeps searching via other servers. Routes and timetables also switch on their own when a server fails
Anonymous usage statistics: once a day, without ID, location or search terms – can be switched off under Settings → Data
Search, routes and timetables can now switch between several servers on their own when one fails
